product_overview: Sello is an Arabic RTL classifieds marketplace that lets users browse, search, and inspect listings without signing in. It also supports account access, profile/settings management, and language selection for a localized shopping experience.
core_goals: Browse marketplace listings from the home feed
Open listing details to review photos, price, and seller information
Browse listings within a selected category
Access account and app settings after signing in
Change the app language without signing in

features.name: Guest Home Browse
features.description: Users can explore the main Sello marketplace feed without creating an account.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Land on the home feed -> Scroll through featured and latest listings -> Tap a category from the grid -> Browse listings in that category -> Tap a listing card to open its details
Navigate to /home -> View the home marketplace feed -> Scroll through listings -> Tap a listing card to open its details

features.name: Search Listings
features.description: Users can search the marketplace by keyword and review the matching results.
user_flows: Navigate to /search -> Enter a search query -> View the matching listing results
Navigate to /search -> Enter a search query with no matches -> View the empty state

features.name: Listing Detail
features.description: Users can inspect a listing in detail, including its gallery, price, seller section, and related seller listings.
user_flows: Navigate to /listing/:id -> Open a listing from the home feed -> Scroll through the image gallery and listing details -> Review the seller information section -> View the seller's other listings row

features.name: Category Browse
features.description: Users can browse marketplace listings filtered by a selected category.
user_flows: Navigate to /categories/:categoryId -> Open a category from the home feed -> Scroll through the category listing results

features.name: Account Profile
features.description: Signed-in users can access their profile and account menu.
user_flows: Navigate to /profile -> View the profile screen and account menu
Navigate to /profile -> View the profile screen -> Open account options from the menu

features.name: App Settings
features.description: Signed-in users can access application settings.
user_flows: Navigate to /settings -> View the settings screen

features.name: Language Settings
features.description: Users can switch the app language without signing in.
user_flows: Navigate to /language -> View the available language options -> Select a language -> Return with the app language updated

features.name: Phone Login Entry
features.description: Users can start the phone-based login flow from the app's login entry screen.
user_flows: Navigate to /phone -> View the phone login entry screen -> Enter the phone number to begin sign-in
